group_info.name: asmerr
group_info.description: Source the assembler must reject, each with exit status 2 and the E_ASM error code.

group_info.name: binary
group_info.description: The on-disk module format: byte-exact assembler output, constant-pool interning order, the canonical disassembly, and assemble/disassemble round-tripping.

group_info.name: loader
group_info.description: Module validation: every field the loader must check before the first instruction runs, driven from hand-built byte images.

group_info.name: arith
group_info.description: Integer arithmetic: wrapping two's-complement add/sub/mul, truncating div, sign-of-dividend mod, negation, and the division and overflow edge cases the spec pins down.

group_info.name: bitwise
group_info.description: Bitwise AND/OR/XOR/NOT and the two shifts, including the arithmetic right shift on negative values and the shift-count range rule.

group_info.name: compare
group_info.description: Equality, inequality and ordering over integers, strings and reference values, plus the type rules for mixed comparisons.

group_info.name: strops
group_info.description: String operations: concatenation, byte-indexed substring, search, length, chr/ord and the string/integer conversions.

group_info.name: control
group_info.description: Conditional and unconditional jumps, truthiness, loop shapes, and the stack discipline of the conditional branches.

group_info.name: locals
group_info.description: Local slots: default initialisation, store and load, parameter binding, per-frame isolation, and the stack shuffling opcodes.

group_info.name: globals
group_info.description: The global name table: definition on first store, lookup failure, visibility across frames, and quoted global names.

group_info.name: calls
group_info.description: Frames, argument binding, return values, recursion, mutual recursion, arity checking and the call-site type rules.

group_info.name: closures
group_info.description: Closure creation, by-value upvalue capture, upvalue mutation, capture chains through nested functions, and closures as first-class values.

group_info.name: arrays
group_info.description: Array construction, element access, mutation, growth, reference semantics and the index range rules.

group_info.name: display
group_info.description: The display form used by PRINT, WRITE and TOSTR, including quoting inside arrays and the type names reported by TYPEOF.

group_info.name: errors
group_info.description: Every runtime trap, its error code and its process exit status, plus the rule that output already written survives.

group_info.name: depth
group_info.description: The call-depth limit and the operand-stack limit: the boundary cases either side of each, and the errors they raise.

group_info.name: gc
group_info.description: The observable heap: which operations allocate, what the root set contains, that cycles are reclaimed, and that a bounded heap is enough for an unbounded amount of garbage.

group_info.name: trace
group_info.description: The instruction trace: one line per executed instruction with the frame depth, function index, byte offset and stack size.

group_info.name: integration
group_info.description: Whole programs that exercise many subsystems at once: real algorithms written in the assembly language.
